name: nudgelink
description: Check outreach campaign results, read prospect replies and draft messages from your NudgeLink sales prospecting workspace.

interface.longDescription: NudgeLink is a B2B sales prospecting workspace: it finds the right people for a campaign and runs LinkedIn outreach that the account owner reviews. This plugin brings that workspace into ChatGPT for sales teams and founders. Check how each outreach campaign performs, read replies from prospects, look up your leads and campaign targeting, and draft connection notes or first messages in your own voice. It is read-only apart from drafting: it cannot send, schedule or approve any message, and drafts are not saved. You review and send every message in NudgeLink. Requires a NudgeLink account.
defaultPrompt: Compare the reply rates of my campaigns
Show me my newest replies and who sent them
Draft a first message for my newest lead
